study: P136: 99 / bobo original LightX2V vs default DARE-TIES on h3-apple 0.5.2
result: In this comparison, switching back to the original LightX2V LoRA on the same v0.5.2 engine reduced ghosting in both motion cases, most clearly in the run. The dialogue case was approximately equal. Some blurred transition frames remain; this is a partial improvement.
limitations: This regression comparison covers three known cases with one fixed seed per case. Visual judgments use non-blind sampled frames and consecutive original frames around key actions. Multi-rater blind review, full continuous-motion perception and subjective listening were not completed. ASR supports wording checks only; it does not establish voice quality or phoneme-level lip sync. Results do not generalize to all subjects or seeds. The experiment itself did not change product defaults.
controls: Same engine, base assets, prompt, reference pixels, seed and actual compute routes; only adapter and model identity changed. A fresh default dialogue replay matched the historical MP4, RGB and PCM before historical default videos were reused.
timing_scope: Times cover only the native_generation stage. The saved defaults and candidates ran on different days. The default dialogue replay matched byte for byte, but these cross-day timings do not establish a controlled speed improvement.

cases.title: Two-speaker Mandarin dialogue
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 99, the single pastel-pink rabbit whose identity is shown in the three views of <Picture 1>: long upright ears with darker pink centers, rounded cheeks, black dot eyes, tiny dark nose, a yellow pinafore with one pink square front pocket over a white short-sleeved shirt, and white shoes. The views describe one character.
<Subject 2> is bobo, the single caramel-brown bear whose identity is shown in the three views of <Picture 2>: round ears with cream centers, a cream oval muzzle, dark dot eyes and black nose, pink cheek circles, sage-green short-sleeved T-shirt with one yellow chest pocket, cream shorts, and white shoes. The views describe one character.
<Subject 3> is the soft hand-painted 2D storybook style and pastoral spring color palette of <Picture 3>: warm dark-brown contour lines, rounded simple characters against softly painted greenery, yellow-green grass, tiny wildflowers, distant blue-green hills, and warm sunlight. This is a style reference; the target cast consists of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] In a five-second conversational scene, 99 <Subject 1> and bobo <Subject 2> enjoy a sunny park morning and exchange two warm Mandarin lines, preserving their identities and the painted style of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one pink rabbit with the long ears, face, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes shown in the identity reference.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one brown bear with cream muzzle and ear centers, green shirt, yellow chest pocket, cream shorts and white shoes shown in the identity reference.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the defined soft painted 2D storybook style, warm brown outlines, spring greens, wildflowers and morning sunlight in the new park action.

detailed_description:
The target is a clean full-screen hand-drawn 2D cartoon, with soft painted spring park scenery in the style of <Subject 3>. A pale beige path lies before green trees, small flowers and distant blue-green hills. Warm morning sunlight comes from the upper right.
[Shot 1] A fixed medium two-shot frames the two characters from the knees upward with both complete heads, ears and hands visible. Bobo <Subject 2> is on the left, and 99 <Subject 1> is on the right, each turned three-quarters toward the other. They stand at an easy conversational distance on the park path. The composition remains stable throughout five seconds. From 0.2 to 2.1 seconds the rabbit <Subject 1>, with a bright medium-high youthful female Mandarin voice, a light warm timbre and clear standard pronunciation (S1), looks at the bear, smiles and says: <d>[Chinese] 今天精神真好！</d> The bear listens with his lips closed and eyes directed toward her. After a small pause, from 2.4 to 4.5 seconds the bear <Subject 2>, with a warm medium-low youthful male Mandarin voice, rounded timbre and clear standard pronunciation (S2), answers her with a relaxed smile: <d>[Chinese] 因为有你陪我呀！</d> The rabbit listens during his turn and gives one small happy nod near the end. The two visible mouths articulate their respective lines. The final half second holds the pair smiling at each other with their hands relaxed at their sides.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet morning birds and a light breeze through the leaves remain below the two foreground Mandarin speaking turns. The short pause between the lines stays clear.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
cases.verdict: Approximately equal. Both preserve the characters, clothing and rabbit-then-bear order of mouth movement. Unprompted ASR matched both target lines.
observations: Sampled frames from 0–4.958s retain one rabbit, one bear and their original clothing. Mouth activity is mainly in the first half for 99 and the second half for bobo.
Both raw ASR outputs read “今天精神真好因为有你陪我呀”.

summary:
[reference generation] A five-second side-tracking park run with 99 <Subject 1> and bobo <Subject 2>, preserving the referenced outfits and warm illustrated scenery of <Subject 3>. Their sustained running and stable bodies are the focus.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one pink rabbit with the long ears, face, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes shown in the identity reference.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one brown bear with cream muzzle and ear centers, green shirt, yellow chest pocket, cream shorts and white shoes shown in the identity reference.

detailed_description:
The target is a clean full-screen hand-drawn 2D cartoon, with soft painted spring park scenery in the style of <Subject 3>. A pale beige path lies before green trees, small flowers and distant blue-green hills. Warm morning sunlight comes from the upper right.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide full-body side view shows bobo <Subject 2> on the left and 99 <Subject 1> on the right, already jogging together from left to right along the beige park path. The rabbit is about half a body length ahead; their bodies remain separate and their whole heads, ears, hands, legs and shoes are visible. The camera tracks smoothly to the right at their jogging speed so both stay centered while trees and flowers pass slowly to the left behind them. Over the entire five seconds both characters perform a continuous comfortable jog: their left and right feet alternate contact with the ground, knees bend in coherent short strides, opposite arms swing naturally, and the rabbit's ears bounce gently. Their heads stay recognizable and their original clothes retain their shapes and colors. They exchange a quick cheerful sideways glance near the middle while continuing forward at the same pace, then look ahead again. The shot ends while both are still jogging together. Soft rhythmic shoe taps match the footfalls; both remain silent.

overall_soundscape:
Regular light footsteps alternate against the dry path, with faint leaf rustle and distant bird calls. The characters are silent; there is no speech, singing or narration.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
cases.verdict: Original LightX2V is clearer in this case. At 1.08–1.25s, 1.50s and 1.67–1.83s, overlapping wrist, shorts and shoe contours are more apparent with the default adapter. Both complete the sustained run.
observations: Sampled frames from 0–4.958s and every frame from 1–2s show alternating steps, 99 leading and background motion to the left. The clearer appearance is not obtained by reducing the main action.

Frames 26–30, 36 and 40–44 show layered wrist, shorts and shoe contours with the default adapter; corresponding original-LoRA frames mostly have a single contour. Frame 44 was inspected at the full 1366×768 size in both outputs.
The rabbit arm still briefly blurs in original-LoRA frame 37 (1.542s). Foreground flowers also occlude parts of the feet; occlusion is not classified as an extra limb.
Unprompted ASR produces “字幕by索兰娅” in both outputs, suspected to be a non-speech hallucination. It does not establish actual dialogue, subtitles or compliance with a no-dialogue request.

cases.title: Bread handoff and prop continuity
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 99, the single pastel-pink rabbit whose identity is shown in the three views of <Picture 1>: long upright ears with darker pink centers, rounded cheeks, black dot eyes, tiny dark nose, a yellow pinafore with one pink square front pocket over a white short-sleeved shirt, and white shoes. The views describe one character.
<Subject 2> is bobo, the single caramel-brown bear whose identity is shown in the three views of <Picture 2>: round ears with cream centers, a cream oval muzzle, dark dot eyes and black nose, pink cheek circles, sage-green short-sleeved T-shirt with one yellow chest pocket, cream shorts, and white shoes. The views describe one character.
<Subject 3> is the soft hand-painted 2D storybook style and pastoral spring color palette of <Picture 3>: warm dark-brown contour lines, rounded simple characters against softly painted greenery, yellow-green grass, tiny wildflowers, distant blue-green hills, and warm sunlight. This is a style reference; the target cast consists of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] In a five-second two-character park scene, 99 <Subject 1> gives one bread roll to bobo <Subject 2>. The visible transfer and two short Mandarin lines unfold in the warm painted style of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one pink rabbit with the long ears, face, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes shown in the identity reference.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one brown bear with cream muzzle and ear centers, green shirt, yellow chest pocket, cream shorts and white shoes shown in the identity reference.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the defined soft painted 2D storybook style, warm brown outlines, spring greens, wildflowers and morning sunlight in the new park action.

detailed_description:
The target is a clean full-screen hand-drawn 2D cartoon, with soft painted spring park scenery in the style of <Subject 3>. A pale beige path lies before green trees, small flowers and distant blue-green hills. Warm morning sunlight comes from the upper right.
[Shot 1] A locked-off medium two-shot shows bobo <Subject 2> on the left and 99 <Subject 1> on the right facing one another, with both complete faces and their hands visible. At the start the rabbit holds one small golden oval bread roll with three pale diagonal scoring marks in her right paw at chest height, and the bear's two paws are empty. From 0.2 to 1.8 seconds the rabbit <Subject 1>, with a bright medium-high youthful female Mandarin voice, a light warm timbre and clear standard pronunciation (S1), looks at the bear and says: <d>[Chinese] 这个面包给你。</d> As she speaks she extends the same roll toward him across the small gap. From about 1.5 to 2.6 seconds the bear reaches forward with both paws, visibly supports the offered roll, and the rabbit releases it and retracts her now-empty right paw. By 2.7 seconds the bear alone holds the one roll at his chest. From 2.8 to 4.4 seconds the bear <Subject 2>, with a warm medium-low youthful male Mandarin voice, rounded timbre and clear standard pronunciation (S2), smiles at the rabbit and replies: <d>[Chinese] 谢谢，真香！</d> The rabbit listens with both hands empty. In the last half second the bear lifts the bread slightly toward his nose with a pleased expression while the rabbit smiles at him. The single bread stays in the bear's paws at the end. The camera retains both faces and the entire hand-to-hand transfer in the same steady frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft birds and park leaf rustle sit beneath the two clear Mandarin lines. A very quiet clothing rustle accompanies the reach and transfer.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
cases.verdict: Original LightX2V has cleaner handoff and lifting transitions. Inspect 2.50–2.71s and 4.46–4.71s. Both complete the transfer, and only bobo holds the roll in the final frame.
observations: Default-adapter frames 60–61 (2.500–2.542s) and 64–65 (2.667–2.708s) have overlapping bread/hand/face contours. The original LoRA is more concentrated, though frames 60 and 64 retain slight softening.

The rabbit hand is visibly separated from the roll by original-LoRA frame 60 (2.500s), versus about frame 62 (2.583s) with the default adapter. Afterward, the bear holds the roll in both hands and the rabbit has empty hands in both outputs.

Default-adapter frames 107–113 (4.458–4.708s) show more pronounced bread, hand and mouth-area trails during the lift. The original LoRA reduces them, with slight bread/face-edge blur remaining in frame 108. Frame 108 was inspected at native size in both outputs; final frame 119 retains one roll in the bear’s hands.
Both outputs start with two hands supporting the roll, rather than strictly following the requested right-hand-only starting pose. This is not a new defect introduced by the original LoRA.
Unprompted ASR matches “这个面包给你，谢谢，真香” in both outputs; only word-spacing differs in the candidate.
